c74object.name: el.magfreq_analysis~
c74object.digest: Phase vocoder magnitude and frequency spectral analysis
c74object.description:
el.magfreq_analysis~ performs real-time phase vocoder spectral analysis on an incoming audio signal, converting it into synchronous magnitude and instantaneous frequency vectors. The outputs are designed to drive additive resynthesis objects (such as oscbank~ or ioscbank~), enabling spectral warping, pitch manipulation, and filtering between analysis and resynthesis. The FFT frame size is determined by the Max signal vector size and the specified overlap factor.
Inlets
Inlet 1 (signal / messages): Audio signal input to be analyzed, and control message inlet (overlap, winfac, fftinfo, mute, bypass).
Outlets
Outlet 1 [Left Outlet] (signal): Magnitude vector. Emits the calculated amplitude for each spectral bin across the vector.
Outlet 2 [Middle Outlet] (signal): Frequency vector. Emits the instantaneous frequency (in Hz) for each spectral bin across the vector.
Outlet 3 [Right Outlet] (signal): Bin index. Emits a linear ramp of bin numbers (0, 1, 2, ... N-1) corresponding to the vector samples.

inlet.description: Incoming audio signal to be analyzed, as well as configuration messages.

outlet.description: Outputs the instantaneous magnitude for each spectral bin.
Outputs the instantaneous frequency in Hertz for each spectral bin.
Outputs a linear index ramp identifying each spectral bin (0 to N-1).

objarg.name: low-frequency
objarg.description: The lower boundary of the analysis frequency range in Hertz (default: 0.0 Hz).

objarg.name: high-frequency
objarg.description: The upper boundary of the analysis frequency range in Hertz (default: 4000.0 Hz).

objarg.name: overlap
objarg.description: Analysis overlap factor (default: 4). Must be a power of 2.

objarg.name: window-factor
objarg.description: Window size multiplier relative to the FFT frame size (default: 2). Must be a power of 2.

method.name: bypass
method.description: When set to 1, analysis calculation is bypassed and outputs emit zeroes. When set to 0 (default), normal spectral analysis runs.

method.name: fftinfo
method.description: Prints the current FFT size, hop size, and window size in samples to the Max Console.

method.name: mute
method.description: When set to 1, mutes DSP computation and outputs silence. When set to 0 (default), analysis resumes.

method.name: overlap
method.description: Sets the analysis overlap factor. Must be a power of 2 (e.g. 2, 4, 8).

method.name: winfac
method.description: Sets the window size multiplier relative to the FFT frame size. Must be a power of 2 (e.g. 1, 2, 4).

method.name: signal
method.description: Audio signal stream to be decomposed into magnitude and frequency vectors.
